story_overview: MSVBench story 02 (Children's Picture Books). Narration: David's mom always says, 'David, no!' David! Don't be noisy! David says, 'Mom, hug.' His mom says, 'Sweetie, come here!' David, be good... I love you!

video_prompts: Daytime, living room at home, cozy but slightly messy, family photos hanging on the wall, children's books scattered on the sofa, a half-full cup of coffee on the coffee table, soft natural light filtering through the curtains. Full view of the living room, no characters. Narration: David's mom always says, 'David, no!'. Full shot, eye level shot.

Daytime, kitchen, tidy cabinets with various utensils and spice bottles, a candy box placed on the central island, sunlight streaming through the window onto the floor. David stands on the stool, reaching for the candy box, his expression focused, leaning slightly forward. One day, David stood on a stool, trying to reach his mom's candy box. Is this okay?. Medium shot, low-angle shot.

Daytime, home entryway, mud scattered on the floor, coat hooks on the wall, shoes neatly arranged on a shoe rack, bright lighting. David stands in the entryway, mud around his feet, his mom beside him with a helpless expression, pointing at the shoe rack. David walked into the room covered in mud, getting dirt all over the floor. Oh no! David, no! Take off your shoes and put on slippers!. Medium long shot, eye level shot.

Evening, bathroom, water stains on the floor, bathtub filled with water, towels hanging on the wall, soft yellow lighting. David plays in the bathtub, holding a toy boat, water splashing around, looking excited. It's bath time. He's playing pirate and water is splashing everywhere. David, no! Turn off the faucet. Medium close up, eye level shot.

Evening, home hallway, paintings hanging on the wall, clean and tidy floor, soft lighting. David runs naked down the hallway, his mom chasing after him, looking anxious. David, come back! Go to your room and put on clothes. You can't run around naked. Medium shot, high-angle shot.

Night, David's bedroom, toys scattered on the bed, cartoon posters on the wall, warm light from a bedside lamp. David jumps on the bed, shouting loudly, looking happy. David! Don't be noisy!. Medium close up, eye level shot.

Evening, dining room, table filled with food, chairs neatly arranged around it, warm lighting. David sits at the table, poking the figure with food, his mom sitting across from him, looking serious. It's dinner time. David is poking a little figure with potatoes and a chicken leg. His mom says, 'David, don't play with food!'. Medium shot, eye level shot.

Evening, dining room, most of the food on the table has been eaten, lighting still warm. David's mouth is stuffed with food, cheeks puffed out, looking satisfied. During dinner, David stuffs a lot of food into his mouth. His mom says, 'Don't eat so much!'. Medium close up, eye level shot.

Night, David's bedroom, blankets kicked to the side, dim light from a bedside lamp. David wears a superhero costume, standing on the bed, picking his nose, his mom standing beside the bed with a helpless expression. It's bedtime. David is playing superhero. His mom says, 'David, go to sleep! Don't pick your nose!'. Medium close up, eye level shot.

Night, living room, a soft pillow on the sofa, a glass of water on the coffee table, soft lighting. David snuggles in his mom's arms, his mom hugging him, looking gentle, speaking softly. David says, 'Mom, hug.' His mom says, 'Sweetie, come here!' David, be good... I love you!. Medium close up, eye level shot.
